$description: CODE-OWNED. Not in Figma, and not overwritten by `npm run sync:figma`. Figma Variables support only Color, Number, String and Boolean — there is no shadow type and no easing type, so these cannot be design variables. Shadows exist in the Figma file as EFFECT STYLES; if the designer changes them, transcribe the change here by hand.

elevation.$description: Navy-tinted rather than neutral gray, so shadows sit in the palette instead of muddying it. Short ladder on purpose: a long one gets used decoratively.
